_comment: Incident probability calibrations. Each preset overrides keys in events.json (base_probabilities, severity_ranges, ttr_ranges_minutes, locations). Per-hour probabilities — evaluated once per simulated hour by the injector.

simulated.label: Simulated (default)
simulated.description: Heuristic probabilities tuned for visible incidents during demonstration runs.

asrs_historical.label: FAA ASRS calibrated
asrs_historical.description: Per-hour probabilities derived from FAA Aviation Safety Reporting System (ASRS) public summaries 2022–2024, normalised against ART nominal traffic (~40 movements/peak-hour). Adds bird strike and medical emergency categories observed in the dataset.
